audit_metadata.phase: Phase 3 Repository Rationalization Verification & Audit Reconciliation

discrepancy_explanation_50097_vs_50098.count_50097: Exact number of records in Documents/MediMind_Repository_Inventory_Phase2.json and .csv at time of export (prior to writing report file and CSV itself to disk).
discrepancy_explanation_50097_vs_50098.count_50098: Theoretical calculated after total in Phase 2 report Table J (50,146 - 59 + 11 = 50,098).
discrepancy_explanation_50097_vs_50098.delta_reconciliation: 50,097 base inventory + 1 report (.md) + 1 CSV manifest + 1 JSON manifest = 50,100 actual target files on disk.

cohort_414_october_28.description: Gross candidate pool of past unclosed appointments evaluated across 3 hospitals (Harborview: 256, Aarogyam: 107, Nexora: 51).

cohort_274_october_29.description: Refined cohort audited in Phase 19 (phase19_inspect_274_details.mjs) with cutoff 2026-10-29T19:00:00.000Z in active hospitals.
cohort_274_october_29.evaluation: Identified exactly 274 past unclosed appointments lacking clinical evidence (no check-in, no consult, no Rx) alongside 23 future legitimate pending appointments (274 + 23 = 297).
cohort_274_october_29.clinical_governance_decision: Preserved without automatic completion or cancellation under strict clinical safety rules.

clinical_record_reconciliation_414_vs_27.synthesis: The 414 figure was the gross October 28 candidate pool; 274 was the refined unclosed subset with insufficient evidence. Stating all 414 were resolved was an overstatement; they were classified and reconciled.

mock_data_elimination_qualification.production_environment: 100% eliminated. All hardcoded arrays, random number generators, and placeholder fixtures removed from MongoDB Atlas and client UI code.
mock_data_elimination_qualification.local_staging_environment: 387 synthetic demonstration appointments generated exclusively within local isolated MongoDB (medimind_staging_appointment) for high-concurrency rehearsal.
mock_data_elimination_qualification.production_safeguards: assertStagingEnvironment(uri) strictly blocks synthetic generation against production Atlas URI.
